M1_header_not_opened._note: The pre-#4379 reading: the header is stored but its body is never absorbed, so every reader sees `|-`.

M2_body_check_after_items._note: Body lines shaped like items / comments fall through to the list branches — the two LIVE sub-shapes (f212f1b9, 12f27c54).

M3_inner_blank_dropped._note: A blank line inside the body is swallowed instead of kept (0 live carriers — ratchet).

M4_trailing_blank_absorbed._note: A blank line is absorbed eagerly, so the blank after the body joins it — the write side (`findPropertyLineSpan`) does not own it.
